Package com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in

Class KfeChannelDecisionService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.KfeChannelDecisionService
@Service public class KfeChannelDecisionService extends Object
Strict binary AND decisions for channel structural actions (doc §3). Does not execute LND mutations — only evaluates flags.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeChannelDecisionService

      public KfeChannelDecisionService(KfeQuorumGateway quorumGateway, KfeSystemWalletService systemWalletService, KfeLightningJammingGuard jammingGuard, ChannelsMeshInjectGateway channelsMeshInject, @Value("${kfe.channel.min-open-capital-sats:10000000}") long minOpenCapitalSats, @Value("${kfe.channel.max-onchain-fee-rate-sat-vb:50}") long maxOnchainFeeRateSatVb, @Value("${kfe.channel.rebalance-drain-ratio:0.20}") double rebalanceDrainRatio, @Value("${kfe.channel.drain-deterrent-ppm:5000}") long drainDeterrentPpm, @Value("${kfe.channel.break-even-ppm:1000}") long breakEvenPpm, @Value("${kfe.lightning.peer-denylist:}") String peerDenylistCsv, @Value("${kfe.channel.require-mpc:true}") boolean requireMpcForStructural, @Value("${kfe.channel.require-channels-mesh-inject:false}") boolean requireChannelsMeshInject)
      Creates the non-mutating channel policy evaluator and normalizes all configured thresholds.
      Parameters:
      quorumGateway - unanimous structural-action approval provider
      systemWalletService - SYSTEM_PROFIT wallet resolver
      jammingGuard - Lightning peer/jamming safety evaluator
      channelsMeshInject - mesh capital authorization provider
      minOpenCapitalSats - minimum local channel capital, clamped nonnegative
      maxOnchainFeeRateSatVb - maximum fee rate, clamped to at least one sat/vbyte
      rebalanceDrainRatio - drained-channel ratio threshold, clamped to 0..1
      drainDeterrentPpm - minimum accelerated-drain fee target, clamped nonnegative
      breakEvenPpm - acceptable baseline routing fee threshold, clamped nonnegative
      peerDenylistCsv - comma-separated peer public keys excluded from opening
      requireMpcForStructural - require unanimous quorum on structural operations
      requireChannelsMeshInject - require mesh authorization for opening

  • Method Details

    • evaluateOpen

      public ChannelDecisionResult evaluateOpen(String peerPubkey, long localAmountSats, long estimatedFeeRateSatVb, boolean anchorsEnabled, String proposalHash)
      Evaluates an OPEN proposal as the conjunction of capital, known/bounded fee, anchors, MPC, peer allowability, and optional mesh-injection gates; it does not mutate provider or ledger state.
      Parameters:
      peerPubkey - remote peer public key
      localAmountSats - requested local channel capital
      estimatedFeeRateSatVb - estimated chain fee rate, which must be positive and within the cap
      anchorsEnabled - whether the proposal includes the required anchor outputs
      proposalHash - stable proposal identity used for quorum approval
      Returns:
      per-flag evidence and aggregate OPEN pass result

    • evaluateRebalance

      public ChannelDecisionResult evaluateRebalance(LightningChannelGateway.ChannelSnapshot channel, long estimatedRebalanceCostSats, long expectedFutureGainSats)
      Evaluates a rebalance using drained local liquidity, positive expected gain net of cost, and SYSTEM_PROFIT wallet availability gates.
      Parameters:
      channel - current channel snapshot, or null when channel data is unavailable
      estimatedRebalanceCostSats - expected rebalance cost
      expectedFutureGainSats - expected future routing gain
      Returns:
      per-flag evidence and aggregate REBALANCE pass result

    • evaluateClose

      public ChannelDecisionResult evaluateClose(LightningChannelGateway.ChannelSnapshot channel, boolean peerOfflineBeyondThreshold, boolean cooperativePossible, boolean anchorsOk, long currentFeeRateSatVb)
      Evaluates a CLOSE proposal: the channel must be dead/offline, and close must be cooperative or satisfy the anchor plus bounded-force-fee fallback.
      Parameters:
      channel - current channel snapshot
      peerOfflineBeyondThreshold - whether external monitoring confirms prolonged peer absence
      cooperativePossible - whether a cooperative close is available
      anchorsOk - whether anchor policy permits the force-close fallback
      currentFeeRateSatVb - current chain fee-rate estimate
      Returns:
      per-flag evidence and aggregate CLOSE pass result

    • evaluatePpm

      public ChannelDecisionResult evaluatePpm(long currentPpm, boolean acceleratedDrain)
      Evaluates the product's OR rule for fee-policy adjustment: either below-break-even pricing or an accelerated-drain signal is actionable. When one rule is not needed, its returned flag is padded as a pass so the result object's aggregate AND remains true for the OR-selected action.
      Parameters:
      currentPpm - current channel forwarding fee in parts per million
      acceleratedDrain - whether channel monitoring raised a drain alert
      Returns:
      flag evidence whose aggregate passes if either action condition is met

    • recommendedPpm

      public long recommendedPpm(long currentPpm, boolean acceleratedDrain)
      Recommends a deterrent ppm: accelerated drain raises but never lowers the current fee; otherwise a below-break-even fee is raised above break-even by one quarter of that threshold, capped at the configured drain deterrent. Above-break-even fees are left unchanged.
      Parameters:
      currentPpm - current forwarding fee in parts per million
      acceleratedDrain - whether a drain alert is active
      Returns:
      recommended forwarding ppm
